# re_wor - ReXGlue Recompiled Project
# Generated by: rexglue init
#
# This file is SDK-managed. Running 'rexglue migrate' will overwrite it.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(re_wor LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

set(REXSDK_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/thirdparty/rexglue-sdk" CACHE PATH "Path to rexglue-sdk source tree")
if(REXSDK_DIR AND EXISTS "${REXSDK_DIR}/CMakeLists.txt")
    add_subdirectory("${REXSDK_DIR}" rexglue-sdk)
else()
    find_package(rexglue QUIET CONFIG)
    if(NOT rexglue_FOUND)
        message(FATAL_ERROR
            "ReXGlue SDK not found. Either:\n"
            "  - Set REXSDK_DIR to the rexglue-sdk source tree (e.g. thirdparty/rexglue-sdk)\n"
            "  - Install the SDK package and ensure it is on CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH")
    endif()
endif()


include(FetchContent)
option(REWOR_ENABLE_DISCORD_RPC "Enable Discord Rich Presence via discord-rpc" ON)
if(REWOR_ENABLE_DISCORD_RPC)
    set(BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
    set(CMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM 3.5)
    set(CLANG_FORMAT_CMD OFF CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
    FetchContent_Declare(discord_rpc
        GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/discord/discord-rpc.git
        GIT_TAG v3.4.0
    )
    FetchContent_MakeAvailable(discord_rpc)
endif()

# Hooks experimentales que REEMPLAZAN funciones originales del juego
# (VFS/LoadFile, materiales, scripts QB, graficos). Cambian la logica del motor
# y provocaban el cuelgue con pantalla negra en el arranque, por eso van
# desactivados por defecto. Activar solo para depurar: -DREWOR_EXPERIMENTAL_HOOKS=ON
option(REWOR_EXPERIMENTAL_HOOKS "Compilar hooks que reemplazan funciones del juego" OFF)
if(REWOR_EXPERIMENTAL_HOOKS)
    list(APPEND REWOR_SOURCES
        src/hooks/materials/dummy_material.cpp
        src/hooks/materials/material_hooks.cpp
        src/hooks/vfs/vfs_hooks.cpp
        src/hooks/graphics/graphics_hooks.cpp
        src/hooks/scripts/script_hooks.cpp
    )
    add_compile_definitions(REWOR_EXPERIMENTAL_HOOKS=1)
endif()

# Sondas de diagnostico del arranque (registran aperturas de archivos, frames
# e interrupciones de VBlank en re_wor_trace.log). Solo para depurar.
option(REWOR_BOOT_PROBES "Compilar sondas de diagnostico del arranque" OFF)
if(REWOR_BOOT_PROBES)
    list(APPEND REWOR_SOURCES src/diagnostics/boot_probe.cpp)
    add_compile_definitions(REWOR_BOOT_PROBES=1)
endif()

# Include generated code if codegen has been run
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated/sources.cmake")
    include(generated/sources.cmake)
    list(APPEND REWOR_SOURCES ${GENERATED_SOURCES})
endif()

if(WIN32)
    list(APPEND REWOR_SOURCES app_icon.rc)
    add_executable(re_wor WIN32 ${REWOR_SOURCES})
else()
    add_executable(re_wor ${REWOR_SOURCES})
endif()

target_include_directories(re_wor PRIVATE
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/generated
    ${REXSDK_DIR}/thirdparty/vulkan-headers/include
)

target_link_libraries(re_wor PRIVATE
    rex::core
    rex::system
    rex::kernel
    rex::gpu-xenos
    rex::ui
)

if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(re_wor PRIVATE winmm d3d11 d3d12 dxgi d3dcompiler dxguid ole32 shell32)
endif()

if(REWOR_ENABLE_DISCORD_RPC)
    target_link_libraries(re_wor PRIVATE discord-rpc)
    target_compile_definitions(re_wor PRIVATE REWOR_HAS_DISCORD_RPC=1)
endif()

# Platform entry point, ReXApp source, and platform-specific settings
rexglue_configure_target(re_wor)

# Developer mode (logging, stub tracking)
option(REWOR_DEV "Enable developer logging (TRACE, StubTracker, crash logs)" ON)
if(REWOR_DEV)
    target_compile_definitions(re_wor PRIVATE REWOR_DEV=1)
endif()

# Output executable name
set_target_properties(re_wor PROPERTIES OUTPUT_NAME "Guitar Hero Warriors of Rock")

# SEH (__try/__except) crash protection for ctor iteration
# clang++ on Windows needs -fasync-exceptions to handle hardware faults in __except
# MSVC needs /EHa explicitly
if(MSVC)
    if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "Clang")
        target_compile_options(re_wor PRIVATE -fasync-exceptions)
    else()
        target_compile_options(re_wor PRIVATE /EHa)
    endif()
endif()

# Codegen target - run 'cmake --build . --target re_wor_codegen'
add_custom_target(re_wor_codegen
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:rex::rexglue> codegen ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/re_wor_config.toml
    WORKING_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
    COMMENT "Generating recompiled code for re_wor"
    VERBATIM
)

# La GPU (rexgpu-xenos) es un plugin que se carga en tiempo de ejecucion: compilarlo con el juego y copiarlo
# junto al ejecutable, para que los cambios en thirdparty/rexglue-sdk/src/graphics lleguen al juego.
if(TARGET rexgpu-xenos)
    add_dependencies(re_wor rexgpu-xenos)
    add_custom_command(TARGET re_wor POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different $<TARGET_FILE:rexgpu-xenos> $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:re_wor>
        COMMENT "Copiando el plugin de GPU junto al juego")
endif()
# Las DLL del SDK cambian sin que el ejecutable se vuelva a enlazar (p. ej. un parche en kernel/xam): copiarlas
# siempre que cambien, no solo cuando se enlaza el juego.
if(TARGET rexruntime AND TARGET rexgpu-xenos)
    add_custom_target(re_wor_sdk_dlls ALL
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different $<TARGET_FILE:rexruntime> $<TARGET_FILE:rexgpu-xenos>
                $<TARGET_FILE_DIR:re_wor>
        DEPENDS re_wor rexruntime rexgpu-xenos
        COMMENT "Copiando las DLL del SDK junto al juego")
endif()

# Scripts QB propios (qb/*.q): se compilan con tools/qbc.py en <carpeta del juego>/qb y el juego los
# registra al arrancar (Options > Graphics, etc.). Solo hace falta Python 3.
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter QUIET)
file(GLOB REWOR_QB_SOURCES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qb/*.q)
if(Python3_Interpreter_FOUND AND REWOR_QB_SOURCES)
    set(REWOR_QB_OUTPUTS "")
    foreach(src ${REWOR_QB_SOURCES})
        get_filename_component(stem ${src} NAME_WE)
        set(out ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/qb/${stem}.qb.xen)
        add_custom_command(OUTPUT ${out}
            COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/qbc.py ${src} ${out}
            DEPENDS ${src} ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/qbc.py
            COMMENT "Compilando qb/${stem}.q")
        list(APPEND REWOR_QB_OUTPUTS ${out})
    endforeach()
    add_custom_target(re_wor_qb ALL DEPENDS ${REWOR_QB_OUTPUTS})
    add_dependencies(re_wor re_wor_qb)
elseif(REWOR_QB_SOURCES)
    message(WARNING "No se encontro Python 3: los scripts de qb/ (menu Options > Graphics) no se compilaran")
endif()

# Herramienta fuera de linea del render nativo (docs/RENDER_NATIVO.md, fase 1): traduce los shaders de la 360
# capturados (cache/shaders/shareable/*.xsh) a HLSL. No forma parte del juego: cmake --build . --target xenos2hlsl
set(XENOS2HLSL_SDK_SOURCES
    ${REXSDK_DIR}/src/graphics/pipeline/shader/shader.cpp
    ${REXSDK_DIR}/src/graphics/format/ucode.cpp
    ${REXSDK_DIR}/src/graphics/pipeline/shader/translator.cpp
    ${REXSDK_DIR}/src/graphics/pipeline/shader/translator_disasm.cpp)
add_executable(xenos2hlsl EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
    tools/xenos2hlsl/main.cpp
    tools/xenos2hlsl/hlsl_translator.cpp
    ${XENOS2HLSL_SDK_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(xenos2hlsl PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/xenos2hlsl)
target_link_libraries(xenos2hlsl PRIVATE rex::core)
target_compile_options(xenos2hlsl PRIVATE -Wno-unused-variable)

# Comprobacion del traductor (docs/RENDER_NATIVO.md, fase 1): compara cada shader traducido, ejecutado en D3D11
# (WARP), contra el interprete de referencia. cmake --build . --target xenos2hlsl_check
if(WIN32)
    add_executable(xenos2hlsl_check EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
        tools/xenos2hlsl/check.cpp
        tools/xenos2hlsl/check_vk.cpp
        tools/xenos2hlsl/hlsl_translator.cpp
        tools/xenos2hlsl/ref_interpreter.cpp
        ${REXSDK_DIR}/src/graphics/register_file.cpp
        ${XENOS2HLSL_SDK_SOURCES})
    target_include_directories(xenos2hlsl_check PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/xenos2hlsl
        ${REXSDK_DIR}/thirdparty/vulkan-headers/include)   # Vulkan se carga en tiempo de ejecucion
    target_link_libraries(xenos2hlsl_check PRIVATE rex::core d3d11 d3dcompiler dxgi)
    target_compile_options(xenos2hlsl_check PRIVATE -Wno-unused-variable)

    # Reproductor de capturas de frame (docs/RENDER_NATIVO.md, fase 3b): vuelve a dibujar un frame capturado con
    # src/de/framecap.cpp en D3D11 con los shaders traducidos, a la escala pedida. cmake --build . --target xfcplay
    add_executable(xfcplay EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
        tools/xfcplay/xfcplay.cpp
        tools/xenos2hlsl/hlsl_translator.cpp
        ${XENOS2HLSL_SDK_SOURCES})
    target_include_directories(xfcplay PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/xenos2hlsl)
    target_link_libraries(xfcplay PRIVATE rex::core d3d11 d3dcompiler dxgi windowscodecs ole32)
    target_compile_options(xfcplay PRIVATE -Wno-unused-variable)

    # Test de verificacion de la Fase 2 y 3 del Render Nativo (nativegfx)
    add_executable(nativegfx_test EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL
        tools/nativegfx_test/main.cpp
        src/nativegfx/state/texture_desc.cpp
        src/nativegfx/device/device_reader.cpp
        src/nativegfx/device/device_tracker.cpp
        src/nativegfx/backend/backend_factory.cpp
        src/nativegfx/backend/d3d11/d3d11_device.cpp
        src/nativegfx/backend/d3d11/d3d11_state_cache.cpp
        src/nativegfx/backend/d3d11/d3d11_shader_cache.cpp
        src/nativegfx/backend/d3d11/d3d11_texture_cache.cpp
        src/nativegfx/backend/d3d11/d3d11_renderer.cpp
        src/nativegfx/backend/d3d12/d3d12_device.cpp
        src/nativegfx/backend/d3d12/d3d12_renderer.cpp
        src/nativegfx/backend/vulkan/vulkan_device.cpp
        src/nativegfx/backend/vulkan/vulkan_renderer.cpp
        src/nativegfx/hybrid/scene_classifier.cpp
        src/nativegfx/hybrid/hybrid_pipeline.cpp
        src/nativegfx/full/surface_manager.cpp
        src/nativegfx/full/vblank_generator.cpp
        src/nativegfx/full/gpu_decoupler.cpp
        src/nativegfx/full/full_pipeline.cpp)
    target_include_directories(nativegfx_test PRIVATE
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src
        ${REXSDK_DIR}/thirdparty/vulkan-headers/include)
    target_link_libraries(nativegfx_test PRIVATE rex::core d3d11 d3d12 dxgi d3dcompiler dxguid)
endif()
